name: Shelf
description: Save open tabs into spaces and shelves and reopen them later. Works offline, needs no account, and tracks nothing.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src https://clerk.autoshelf.site https://api.autoshelf.site; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
